question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Apple)

calls.reasoning: Apple guidance (rev +9-11% on $102.5B, GM 47-48%, opex $19.1-19.4B, OI&E ~$0.35B, tax 16.5%, ~14.65B shares) implies ~$1.97 at midpoint, ~$2.04 at top. Consensus ~$1.98-2.02. Apple habitually beats (FQ3'26 $2.02 vs $1.89; FQ4'25 $1.85 vs ~$1.77), so the median sits a few % above consensus at ~$2.05. Downside: worsening SoC supply constraints, FX, memory cost margin pressure. Tails: GAAP one-off charges (cf. FQ4'24 EU tax charge, $0.97) or minority-investment mark-to-market swings; ~1% each side outside range. No Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold/bookmaker market found.

- Apple has beaten EPS consensus in most recent quarters, typically by 2-7%.
- Resolves off the first reported diluted EPS (GAAP) in Apple's FQ4 press release / 8-K, not adjusted figures.
- Event window: Sept-quarter results released ~Oct 29, 2026; as of Oct 7, the quarter has ended and the report is pending.
- Searched for but not found: Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold markets on Apple EPS, and the exact Q3 diluted share count in the 8-K.
